title: ATENEA remote v1 typed error or refusal
description: A bounded error or refusal. Its request correlation is carried only by the enclosing envelope request_id; this payload has no nested correlation field and its details must not repeat that identity.

details.description: The closed diagnostic detail object selected by the code discriminator in definitions.errorMapping.

allOf.description: Keep the overflow diagnostic directly tied to its oversize error code as well as to the shared complete error matrix.
